'''Clem''' is a modern [[Nomai]] and a friend of [[Neem]].<ref name=friend/> 

They were told the story of [[The Vessel|Escall's Vessel]] as a child.<ref>CLEM: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall's Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.</ref> Clem feared that Neem and his clan were gone too, as they had not sent any messages in a while.<ref>CANNA: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.</ref><ref name=friend>CLEM: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!</ref> However, it turned out that his Vessel ran into trouble during its warp, but that it was now on its way to [[Canna]].<ref>NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: The triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!</ref>

== Trivia ==

* Clem may be named after the ''[[Wikipedia:Clematis|clematis]]'' genus of the buttercup family.
